# DELETE /api/v1/orgs/{org}

Delete an organization

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (reqToken + reqOrgOwnership) · **ID:** `ep-034`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **404** — Organization not found

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | orgAssignment(true) + reqToken + reqOrgOwnership | utility | Resolves org; Validates token; Checks org ownership |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | org.Delete | controller | Calls org.DeleteOrganization(ctx, org, false) |
| 3 | [services](../modules/services.md) | org.DeleteOrganization | service | In transaction: counts repos (fails if >0), checks packages (fails if owns any), deletes all org beans (teams, org_users, team_users, team_units, team_invites, secrets, blockings, action_runners, action_runner_tokens, user record); After tx: removes filesystem directory, deletes avatar from storage |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| reqOrgOwnership requires user to be org owner or site admin | authorization | !ctx.IsUserSiteAdmin() && !IsOrganizationOwner(ctx, orgID, ctx.Doer.ID) |
| Organization cannot be deleted if it still owns repositories or packages | state_transition | count > 0 (repos) || ownsPackages |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Org still has repositories | 500 | internal error | False |
| Org still has packages | 500 | internal error | False |

### Error Paths

- **Org still has repositories** → ctx.APIErrorInternal → 500
- **Org still has packages** → ctx.APIErrorInternal → 500
- **Database error** → ctx.APIErrorInternal → 500

## 🛡️ Resiliency

**Risk Level:** low

| Pattern | Status | Severity | Detail |
|---------|--------|----------|--------|
| non_atomic | ❌ missing | low | Filesystem and storage cleanup happen after transaction commit. If they fail, DB records are already deleted but files remain orphaned. |

**Non-atomic operations:**
- ⚠️ DB deletion committed before filesystem/storage cleanup; orphaned files possible on cleanup failure

**Cascading failure risk:** Storage failure leaves orphaned files but org is functionally deleted

**Graceful degradation:** none
